description: This file implements a persistent deduplication helper that combines in-memory caching with lock-protected disk storage, providing functions to check and record duplicates, warm up cache from disk, and manage memory.

methods.name: mergeLockOptions
methods.description: Merges user-provided lock options with default lock options.

methods.name: sanitizeData
methods.description: Sanitizes input data to ensure it is a record of string keys to finite positive numbers.

methods.name: pruneData
methods.description: Removes expired or excess entries from the deduplication data based on TTL and max entries.

methods.name: createPersistentDedupe
methods.description: Factory function that creates a persistent deduplication helper with in-memory cache and disk storage.
